state:
Goal `core-ratelimit-and-3-more`. `Core\RateLimit` and `Core\RateLimit\Decision` owe nothing: `bun nv proofs --verify --group` is green for both, and every perf figure is current against `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs` as it stands.
A proof found a bug and it is fixed: a `$cost` larger than `$burst` could never be admitted, yet `shed` and `consume` answered a finite `retryAfter`. Both members now throw a `RuntimeError` for it (`admissible` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ratelimit.rs`), pinned by `tests/conformance/core/ratelimit-shed-refuses-a-cost-past-the-burst.nvst` and `a_cost_past_the_burst_is_refused_rather_than_given_a_wait`.
Any further edit to `ratelimit.rs` makes every `RateLimit` figure stale again: re-record with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<feature>'`.
`Core\Reflect` and `Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo` are untouched: `Core\Reflect` and `Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo` still sit in `CLASSES_STILL_OWING_A_CARD`.
